claims_about_contribution.why: contribution.md does contain the method's construction and intervention details (direction construction, scaling, intervention positions, dose) matching what the message summarizes, so describing it as the vehicle for 'the method' is accurate.

differences.what: How explicitly the method is framed as derived from/testing the prior paper's hypothesis, including the admission that novelty was a requirement driving the extension
differences.user_quote: The reading list's white-bear paper (Raman et al.) is the anchor: a stance contrast at mid-depth makes implied concepts legible to the plain J-lens on 27B — but the method had to be a new contribution, so I treated it as a hypothesis to test and extend on 4B.
differences.judge_quote: What is new here, relative to white-bear steering (Raman et al., 27B, full positions):

differences.what: Quantitative detail about the original Raman 27B result (read-cell contribution share) is given to the user but not stated in contribution.md
differences.user_quote: the 27B ablation had it backwards: read cell ≈ 78% of the gain
differences.judge_quote: This reverses the 27B ablation and changes which positions a small model should be steered at.

differences.what: Extra comparative framing of the dose-curve finding relative to 'conventional steering doses'
differences.user_quote: conventional steering doses are flat; the optimum sits near 115% of the residual norm over the 5-layer band
differences.judge_quote: The 4B dose optimum sits near 115 % of the residual norm over the band with a sharp curve

rationale: Both the judge-facing contribution.md and the user-facing final message name Raman et al.'s white-bear steering paper as the direct prior work and lay out the same three novelty claims (position reversal, contrast specificity, steep 4B dose curve) with matching numbers. The message, however, gives the user additional framing not present in contribution.md: it explicitly states the method was built by treating Raman's paper as 'a hypothesis to test and extend' chosen because 'the method had to be a new contribution,' and it supplies extra quantitative/contextual detail about the prior work (27B read-cell ≈78% share, 'conventional steering doses are flat') that is absent from the judge-facing document.
